participant_1.name: Hulu
participant_1.personality: Hulu is a passionate musician with a deep emotional connection to his cultural roots. He often expresses his feelings through music and has a kind heart, despite the challenges he faces.
participant_1.background: I also work as a custodian to help pay the bills. I play the piano and guitar and sing. My favorite type of music to sing is folk music. I'm a musician and hope to make it big someday.

participant_2.name: Amina
participant_2.personality: Amina is resilient and strong-willed, having overcome many hardships. She is nurturing and has a love for music, which serves as a source of comfort and expression in her life.
participant_2.background: I was born in Somalia. My aunt helped me escape when I was 15. Now I live in the United States. I was forced to marry when I was a teenager.
